data.name: Grave Magic
data.description: A gravedigger can sacrifice unused extract slots of the level given below or higher to use the following spells as spell-like abilities, using her investigator level as her caster level and her Intelligence to determine DCs: 1st-expeditious excavation; 2nd-calm spirit; 3rd-speak with dead; 4th-rest eternal; 5th-call spirit; 6th-undeath to death.
